chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from 'Anbasah ibn Mus'ab, who said:
Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام said: If you doubt concerning the maghrib prayer, then repeat; and if you doubt concerning the fajr prayer, then repeat.

key_terms.ٱلْفَجْرِ: the fajr prayer, the dawn obligatory salat
key_terms.ٱلْمَغْرِبِ: the maghrib prayer, the sunset obligatory salat

ai.seo_question: What should be done if one doubts in the maghrib or fajr prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning doubt in the maghrib and fajr prayers. Imam Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام instructs that when doubt occurs in either of these obligatory prayers, the prayer is to be repeated.
